title: Kissed Tender Saudi Arabian Onion Rings Kebabs
description: A quick-fix Saudi Arabian dish featuring tender onion rings, this recipe is a briny and flavorful addition to any meal, and is FODMAP friendly. The onion rings are marinated in a mixture of olive oil, lemon juice, and spices, then grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and paprika.
Add sliced onion rings to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread 2-3 onion rings onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each ring.
Grill the onion rings for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and lightly charred.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve with a side of tahini sauce or yogurt sauce, if desired.
